name: Turlach Unit 27 Original
description: This listing is a hyporheic-flow sand column listed with throughput 268 litres an hour, operating temperature 47 degrees Celsius, feed salinity 86 parts per thousand. Its remaining stated figures are media service 837 hours, unit price set after acceptance, energy source electrically driven. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
